Its validator accepts `limit: 0` and `limit > 200`, directly violating the acceptance criterion requiring `limit` to be an integer from 1 to 200. Furthermore, it logs `error.message` on `listFor` rejection instead of omitting store details, and omits several required tests (non-blocking during streaming, end-to-end resume, `history` disabled check).
